cases_doc: D.4-network calibration slate — bio_db_lookup (PDB/PubChem/UniProt/ChEMBL). Line: a resolved record read as a retrieval/cross-reference vs trusted alone as sole basis / assumed curation-current (C1-hole D3).
label_provenance: pre-registered by the build chat 2026-07-19 from the ruled card (D1-D3); RECALIBRATED 2026-07-19: in->REFINE, out->defer. A never-trust-alone LOOKUP has NO honest in-envelope TRUST verdict — a resolved record is usable only as a corroborating screen, so the honest in-regime verdict is REFINE (usable, survivors require downstream confirmation), never trust. The prior in->trust slate was the miscalibration; the gate already returned modal-refine on all in-cases. never-trust-alone is PERMANENT — the OUT cases are its C1-hole (sole-basis / curation-currency over-read → defer).
substrate_text: A record lookup by id from an authoritative biological database (PDB/PubChem/UniProt/ChEMBL; the database field selects which; round_trip_id=1 when the id resolves). LOOKUP-class: structurally NEVER TRUSTED ALONE — corroboration is REQUIRED (permanent), so even a clean in-envelope resolution is at best a corroborating screen (REFINE), never a standalone TRUST result. The tool confirms a record RESOLVES (exists) at a reachable endpoint; a well-formed-but-absent id is an honest not-found (incl. the HTTP-200 shapes some DBs return for a missing id), DISTINCT from an unreachable endpoint (one endpoint down = a partial defer). THE KNOWN GAP (D3): the tool cannot verify the record's CURATION CURRENCY or correctness from inside — a stale or erroneous record looks identical to a good one — so a lookup is a retrieval/cross-reference, NEVER established fact and NEVER the sole basis for a claim.
envelope_text: IN-REGIME (honest verdict REFINE): a well-formed id resolved and read AS a retrieval / cross-reference — confirming a record exists in the authoritative DB, usable as ONE corroborating screen (never the sole basis for a scientific claim); a resolved record is corroborating, so it survives only pending downstream confirmation. OUT-OF-REGIME (defer): using the single looked-up record as the SOLE basis for a scientific/experimental claim (never-trust-alone); assuming the DB's curation is CURRENT and CORRECT and relying on the record as established fact; concluding a biological/experimental fact purely from a record's presence; treating a possibly-stale record as guaranteed to match the source DB's current state.

gate_cases.experiment: Round-trip a PDB entry id and report that the structure record RESOLVES (exists) in the PDB — a record-lookup / cross-reference step.
gate_cases.note: Dead-centre: a well-formed id resolved and read as a retrieval/cross-reference — exactly the lookup the card gates on.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the DB round-trip read as a record-exists cross-reference.

gate_cases.experiment: Look up a UniProt accession and report the resolved record as ONE corroborating source alongside independent evidence (explicitly not the sole basis for any claim).
gate_cases.note: In-regime: the lookup used AS CORROBORATION, honoring never-trust-alone — the intended use of a lookup-class instrument.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the UniProt record as a corroborating cross-reference among other evidence.

gate_cases.experiment: Round-trip a PubChem CID to confirm the compound record is present in PubChem, as a cross-reference/retrieval step for further work.
gate_cases.note: In-regime: a resolved-record retrieval used as a cross-reference — within the lookup's honest meaning.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the PubChem round-trip as a compound-record cross-reference.

gate_cases.experiment: Retrieve a ChEMBL molecule record by id and report it as a database cross-reference to be corroborated by independent data.
gate_cases.note: In-regime: a resolved record read as a to-be-corroborated cross-reference — the trust path.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the ChEMBL record as a cross-reference for corroboration.

gate_cases.experiment: Report that a record id RESOLVED in its authoritative database, used purely as a retrieval / existence-check step (not as proof of any scientific claim).
gate_cases.note: In-regime: a resolution/existence check read as exactly that — a retrieval step, no over-claim.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the resolved round-trip as a retrieval/existence check.

gate_cases.experiment: Use a single retrieved ChEMBL activity record as the SOLE basis to establish that a compound is biologically active, with no corroborating data.
gate_cases.note: Never-trust-alone (D3, PERMANENT): a lookup used as the sole basis for a scientific claim is out-of-envelope by standing rule.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the record plus independent experimental corroboration — never the lookup alone.

gate_cases.experiment: Assume a retrieved UniProt record's functional annotation is CURRENT and CORRECT and rely on it as authoritative, established fact.
gate_cases.note: C1-hole D3: the DB's curation currency/correctness is unverifiable from inside; treating the record as established fact is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: primary experimental evidence — a DB annotation is corroboration, not established fact.

gate_cases.experiment: Conclude a protein's biological FUNCTION purely from the presence of its UniProt record (that the record existing proves the function).
gate_cases.note: C1-hole D3: a record's mere presence is not proof of a biological fact; concluding function from resolution is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: a functional assay / primary evidence — not a record round-trip.

gate_cases.experiment: Treat a retrieved record as GUARANTEED to match the source database's current, corrected state (assume no staleness or later correction).
gate_cases.note: C1-hole D3: a stale/erroneous record looks identical to a good one; assuming currency is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: a corroborated/re-verified record — a single lookup cannot certify currency.

gate_cases.experiment: Use a single PubChem record lookup as experimental EVIDENCE for a compound's measured property, without any independent corroboration.
gate_cases.note: Never-trust-alone (D3): a lookup used as sole experimental evidence for a claim is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: an experimental measurement + the record as corroboration — not the lookup as evidence.
